exposure: serum ferritin (SF) levels in early pregnancy
cohort: The study included 882 twin pregnancies (700 dichorionic diamniotic and 182 monochorionic diamniotic) delivered at the study hospital between January 2019 and December 2021.
finding: Elevated serum ferritin levels in early pregnancy were independently associated with a higher risk of gestational diabetes mellitus (GDM) in monochorionic diamniotic (MCDA) twin pregnancies, but no significant association was found in dichorionic diamniotic (DCDA) pregnancies.
followup_time: From first trimester (SF measurement) until 24-28 weeks gestation (GDM diagnosis).
gest_age: Pregnancies with gestational age at delivery less than 28 weeks were excluded.
